basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast living in Madison, Wisconsin. I recently developed an interest in collecting steelbooks, especially those with unique artwork from international sellers. My day job involves IT support for a local company, and I spend my evenings exploring new hobbies or diving into the latest video games. I'm single, and my Reddit usage peaks during late evenings and weekends when I'm unwinding. Besides steelbooks, I'm also intrigued by emerging technologies and unusual scientific queries.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in IT, primarily gained through a combination of a computer science degree and hands-on experience in tech support. I've recently begun exploring the world of steelbooks and collectible items, mostly learning from online communities and forums. My curiosity extends to science and technology, which often leads me down various rabbit holes on the internet.
